name: STACK
author: Maker Hip
description: A public beta: not everything is finished, the loop and the app's samples are not kept at power-off; SAVE keeps the song. Eight tracks, each one sound from 69 built-in sounds or a sample sent from the Burger Studio app; per track a DJ filter, a 3-band EQ, envelope, LFO, sample edit, arpeggiator and two effects; a 16-step sequencer with swing, time signature and tempo; a one-button looper on REC (up to 8 s, it moves between tracks 8 and 7); PERFORM effects on everything (hold SEL); MIDI clock out or in over USB and Bluetooth MIDI; a limiter on the output. Please report what goes wrong.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hugelton Instruments). Sounds: Maker Hip's own Rock kit and FM bank; the Hugelton Sample Pack by Leo Kuroshita (CC0); Versilian Studios VCSL (CC0); audio rendered from Felucca's presets, with thanks to Leo Kuroshita.
